item.title: Putin unveils new Russian nuclear-powered submarine with hypersonic weapons
item.description: The Kremlin plans to expand its naval fleet with five new nuclear submarines by 2030.

item.title: Hamas chief’s last surviving son escapes Israeli strike in Gaza
item.description: Hamas leader Khalil al-Hayya's last surviving son Izzeldeen survived an Israeli assassination attempt on Friday.

item.title: Israel kills four in Gaza as Hamas chief al-Hayya’s son survives strike
item.description: Four of Khalil al-Hayya's other sons were previously killed by Israeli forces, according to the Palestinian group.

item.title: Mecca pact allies condemn ‘heinous’ Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia
item.description: Officials from Pakistan, Saudi Arabia and Turkiye pledge to protect the kingdom's security during talks in Islamabad.

item.title: ‘Bear trap’: Ukraine hails new operation as Russian casualties mount
item.description: Russian assaults met with stout defence along the front as Western powers discuss ceasefire proposals.

item.title: Funeral prayers held for 31 victims of Egypt tanker crash
item.description: Funeral prayers were held at Cairo’s Al-Azhar Mosque on Friday for 31 people killed when a car collided with a tanker

item.title: Kenyan doomsday cult leader convicted over further 123 deaths
item.description: Paul Mackenzie is found guilty of killing his followers, weeks after being jailed for the mass murder of children.

item.title: Inside Saudi Arabia, Houthi attacks test kingdom's image of security
item.description: Despite the strikes, markets and restaurants in Riyadh remain busy as residents express trust in the government to protect them.

item.title: Desperate appeals from women on death row in Iran after protests
item.description: Female protesters and dissidents are being sentenced to death in numbers not seen for decades, a rights group says.
